challenge.better_approach: Fix Ticket.berth in cairn/machines/ticket to resolve the copy for every stage. Rejected: the berth path is recorded truth about where the gate wrote it, and only sail.verdict reads the file on the far box; the reader is the smallest change.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the commons is pulled on the far box before verdict runs; if not, the copy is absent too and the refusal names both paths, which is the honest outcome.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/tools/chain/chain.py carry_berth (ticket e8fb6bcd23c5) is the writer side, already mirroring every claiming chart berth to <commons>/berths/chart; its _commons_mirror is private, so sail uses the public artifact.roots(). Scratch verdict_far.py (this session) proved the fallback live on 46851816800f (verdict-20261113T165737-8ed4b2ba3550 accepted).
challenge.real_collision: none: RULE 1 holds (sail.py is the cc device and imports the artifact tool, which publishes roots); no intention says verdict must read only instance-space.

answers.falsifier: (1) with the instance-space validate berth absent and its commons copy present, sail.verdict drafts every criterion from the copy and queues at the verdict gate; (2) with neither present it exits 1 naming both paths and queues nothing. WRONG INTENT if the commons copy can differ from the instance-space berth (carry_berth writes it byte-identical).
answers.how: In cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py verdict(): when Path(ref) is not a file, read <commons>/berths/chart/<basename of ref>, with the commons root from cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.roots(); refuse naming both paths when neither exists. One new tooth in cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py.
answers.traces_to: Law 1 (a far box must not re-derive or hand-wrap a berth already carried to the commons) and outline 3.3.4.3 (the ticket crosses a gate from any box by queueing at codemother).
answers.what: sail.py verdict reads a ticket's validate berth on any box, falling back to the commons copy at CairnCommons/berths/chart/<name> when the instance-space path the bus host wrote is absent here.
